in_hebrew.name: Rocky
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Firm, steady, or strong
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rocky הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘roccan’ meaning ‘to rock,’ the name Rocky refers to a person who is firm, steady, or strong. In the context of Christian spirituality, Rocky may also symbolize a foundation of faith or a steadfast commitment to God.
